changelog: Fixes the Hermes CLI-tool integration: applying those settings generated a config.yaml whose model keys were unquoted, so an upstream model ID starting with "[" (e.g. [opencode]deepseek-v4-flash) broke the whole file. Hermes silently fell back to a stale config instead of erroring, so the gateway kept running with the wrong base_url and model list. Leading YAML indicators are now quoted.
